probes_SUPERSEDED.status: SUPERSEDED by probes_fix1 below. Kept because the files are committed and a reader will meet them. Three defects, all found in task 4 review round 1:
probes_SUPERSEDED.defect_1_wrong_counterfactual: serenity's 0.306 was taken from task 3's finding-2 slope arithmetic (0.295 + 0.011) where the 0.011 was computed on the PRE-WINDING tree. It is not the poseVerified fit's crossing, which task 3's own committed sweep puts at 0.2974-0.2981.
probes_SUPERSEDED.defect_2_unpaired: both probes were single page loads compared against MEANS OF OTHER LOADS. Between-load variation then enters the difference. kings-court's probe load sat high, inflating its measured slope from 3.833 to 4.554 and its convention share from 50.1% to 60.1%.
probes_SUPERSEDED.defect_3_method_attribution: this block previously said BOTH counterfactuals came from task 3's luminance-slope decomposition. That was true only of serenity's -- and that is the one that was wrong. kings-court's 0.56 was in fact the sweep crossing (0.5596) all along.

original_block.purpose: Counterfactual exposures: what each apartment's fit would have chosen on the poseVerified population instead of the mandated all-spot one, per task 3's own luminance-slope decomposition (kings-court ~0.56, serenity ~0.306). Applied as a runtime renderer.toneMappingExposure override on the HEAD tree only; NO apartment JSON was touched. These split the measured movement into a render part and a fit-population-convention part directly, instead of propagating task 3's ratio.
original_block.caveat: 0.56 and 0.306 are task 3's estimates of the counterfactual fit, not re-fitted here. The split is exact conditional on those two numbers.

probes_fix1.method: SAME-LOAD PAIRED. Per page load: await __bakeReady, set renderer.toneMappingExposure to the SHIPPED value, __measure(), score; then set it to the COUNTERFACTUAL on the same load, __measure(), score. Two loads per apartment. The convention part is the within-load difference, so between-load variation cancels instead of entering the estimate.
probes_fix1.counterfactual_source: BOTH apartments: the zero crossing of the poseVerified population's luminance diff in task 3's committed <apt>-b4a-task3-exposure-sweep-fixedfov-allspot.json. One method for both, which is the correction to the superseded block.
